role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 或人或狼，狼人锋利的双爪和有力的下颚都是敌人的噩梦。他可以召唤隐形的战狼在前方侦察，或突袭敌人，他变身成狼后会获得极致的速度和力量，追杀敌人或在重重包围下逃出生天。
hero_summary_en: As a man or as a wolf, Lycan devastates enemies with sharp claws and deadly jaws. Summoning stealthy wolves to scout ahead or assault a foe, his wolf transformation grants him the speed and strength to run down his enemies, or escape an ambush.

abilities.name: lycan_summon_wolves
abilities.description_zh: 召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
abilities.description_en: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes_zh: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。
notes_en: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.

shard_loc.en: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
shard_loc.zh: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。

facet_text_en: Summoned Wolves are invulnerable and uncontrollable spirits that do not attack, but provide health and damage bonuses to Lycan.

Max Level increased to %max_level%. Level 5 wolves gain Hamstring, which empowers their attacks to root enemies and cause them to take more physical damage on attacks. Level 6 wolves have Hightail, an active ability that gives wolves phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
facet_text_zh: 召唤的狼为不可控的无敌幽灵，不会攻击，但会为狼人提供生命和攻击力加成。
最高等级可升至%max_level%级。5级精灵狼获得断筋，使他们的攻击可以缠绕敌人，并且使敌人被攻击时承受更多物理伤害。6级精灵狼拥有健步如飞，主动开启后精灵狼获得相位移动状态、闪避、移动速度和攻击速度。

abilities.name: lycan_howl
abilities.description_zh: 使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围%radius%范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。
abilities.description_en: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

abilities.name: lycan_feral_impulse
abilities.description_zh: 提升狼人和所有他控制的单位的生命恢复和攻击力。
abilities.description_en: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

abilities.name: lycan_wolf_bite
abilities.description_zh: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得%lifesteal_percent%%%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过%lifesteal_range%就能共用吸血效果。
abilities.description_en: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain %lifesteal_percent%%% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within %lifesteal_range% range of each other.
notes_zh: 饿狼撕咬的冷却时间与变身的当前等级相同。
notes_en: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.

abilities.name: lycan_apex_predator
abilities.description_zh: 狼人和他控制的单位对中立生物造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

abilities.name: lycan_shapeshift
abilities.description_zh: 狼人展现出他的凶狼形态，获得致命一击的能力，并且提升夜间视野。在变身期间，狼人达到超高移动速度，并且不能被减速。移动速度和致命一击也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。
abilities.description_en: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
notes_zh: 狼人的移动速度不会受到妖术的影响。
notes_en: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.
facet_text_en: Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control. Enemy heroes killed by Lycan or his units extends Shapeshift duration by %kill_duration_extension%s.
facet_text_zh: 移动速度和致命一击加成效果也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。狼人或他的单位击杀敌方英雄后会使变身的持续时间延长%kill_duration_extension%秒。
